metadata.description: HarnessFlow — a constraint-based workflow for building software products with AI agents: seven invariants, three user checkpoints, a product truth layout on disk, and full freedom of method inside those walls.

plugins.name: harness-flow
plugins.description: HarnessFlow v4.0.0: a paradigm rewrite from process control to constraint emergence. One binding constitution (skills/harness/SKILL.md, under 120 lines) defines seven invariants and exactly three user checkpoints (intent / tradeoff / release); everything else — planning, ordering, testing strategy, review depth — is the agent's to decide. Product truth lives on disk in product/ (intent, state, decisions, backlog) and work/<slug>/ (signal, evidence, review). The stdlib-only evidence protocol (skills/harness/scripts/harness.py) records raw command output with exit codes and sha256 content hashes and verifies integrity, but never adjudicates stages — risk scaling is emergent, not configured. Four advisory playbooks (shaping, building, reviewing, releasing) ship as references.
